## Emerald 2.3.0

Emerald 2.3.0 improves search and Read Mode navigation with all-match
highlighting, exact search previews, persistent per-note reading positions,
browser-style history restoration, keyboard jumps, and a heading index.

### Search

- Find in Note highlights every match in Edit and Read Mode, including code
  blocks, with the current match shown slightly lighter. The editor font and
  text size remain unchanged while searching.
- Vault search lists individual occurrences ranked across notes, with line
  numbers and context. No result is selected until navigation begins.
- Arrow keys preview each exact match just above the floating popup. Enter
  keeps the result; Esc restores the original note, selection, and scroll
  position without adding temporary previews to navigation history.
- Both search inputs have a simpler appearance without an inner border.

### Remembered reading positions

- Every note remembers its source-backed reading position across navigation
  and application restarts.
- Back and Forward restore the exact position associated with each visit.
- Positions survive rendering and layout changes as well as note renames and
  moves; stale positions are removed with deleted notes and folders.
- Same-note heading links move within the page without creating another
  history visit or restoring an older position.

### Read Mode navigation

- `g` jumps to the top of the note.
- `G` reveals the last written line without entering the scroll-past-end area.
- `i` opens a filterable, level-indented heading index. Duplicate headings open
  their exact source occurrence, while fenced-code and commented headings are
  excluded.

### Fixes

- Code-block copy buttons in Edit Mode copy the complete code, including lines
  below the viewport, while preserving whitespace and the current selection.
- Linux AppImage processes appear as `emerald` in system monitors instead of
  `AppRun.wrapped`.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
